description: Scale the graphic inside a frame by zoom_factor (greater than 0; 1.2 = 20 % larger) around an anchor of the frame (center, top, bottom, left, right, top_left, top_right, bottom_left, bottom_right; default center). Frame and crop stay. Returns graphic_bounds_mm, frame_bounds_mm and effective_ppi after the zoom (warning below min_ppi; PDFs report none).

anchor.description: Anchor of the frame that stays fixed. Default center.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

min_ppi.description: Effective resolution in ppi below which a warning is given. Default: the configured value, otherwise 300 (the usual offset print value: twice the 150 lpi screen).

zoom_factor.description: Scale factor, e.g. 1.2 for 20 % larger, 0.9 for 10 % smaller.

name: scale_image_in_frame
title: Scale a placed graphic
